items.passage: Making khichuri is easy. First, we wash rice and lentils together. Then we put them in a pot with water. After that, we add salt, oil and spices. Next, we cook it on the stove until it is soft. Finally, we serve the hot khichuri.

subs.q: Step 2: Put them in a pot with ___.
Step 4: Cook it until it is ___.

items.passage: Preparing a cup of Horlicks is simple. First, we take a clean cup. Then we put two spoonfuls of Horlicks in it. After that, we pour hot milk into the cup. Next, we add sugar to taste. Finally, we stir it well and drink it.

subs.q: Step 2: Put two spoonfuls of ___ in it.
Step 3: Pour hot ___ into the cup.

items.passage: Cleaning our teeth after a meal is a good habit. First, we take a little water in the mouth. Then we rinse the mouth well. After that, we brush the teeth if needed. Next, we clean between the teeth. Finally, we wash the mouth with clean water.

subs.q: Step 1: Take a little ___ in the mouth.
Step 5: ___ the mouth with clean water.
